scope: Varied7/14/30-day logic audit; completed-care shortage boundary correction; historic1.0/1.1 reproducibility and matching1.2 comparisons.
data_changes: One new ten-replication run under unchanged egg wo settings was intentionally added after preservation checks. Existing scenario settings and stored protected records are unchanged.
limitations: Finite engineering scenarios and seeded regressions cannot prove every possible input combination.
Synthetic durations, resource ratios and access targets were not calibrated against observed hospital operations.
metric_definitions_to_remember: Success score is first treatment within24 elapsed hours among eligible arrivals; it does not mean admission within24h or clinical outcome.
Staff/equipment loss restricts new placements and reports existing occupied deficits without ejecting patients, as specified; supply outages and explicit disruptions pause care clocks.
